owner: CC (code + proofs + the migration); Akien (the design rulings of 2026-07-30: WATCHME keeps the -ME grammar and means 'emits a probe'; every intention gets a keep-learning step BY DEFAULT and 'none, because X' is the only other legal answer; a verdict artifact is the DEFAULT carriage and not the only one; and the bootstrap-vs-product distinction below, which is his and is load-bearing on the whole design; and the CALLBACK -> PROBE rename, ruled in the same conversation: 'that IS what it does PROGRAMMATICALLY... but what it DOES FUNCTIONALLY is: it's a probe')

questions.a: OPTIONAL TO CARRY, MANDATORY TO SATISFY ONCE CARRIED — Akien's rule, and the exact inversion of the failure it replaces. v1's LEARNME sat in the backbone, mandatory for every node and gated by NOTHING, so it was crossed by every voyage and satisfied by none. WATCHME is skippable and, once carried, physics: crossing forward out of it requires an EMITTED probe (on disk, armed, spec complete). 'none, because X' is the only other legal answer; silence is refused in every form measured (absent, '', 'none', 'n/a', and the truncated 'none, because').

A PROBE CARRIES NO AUTHORITY, and it is structural rather than avoided. cairn/tools/base/probe.py contains neither the string 'transitions' nor 'emit(' — the module cannot reach the one door that moves state even by accident. Probe is frozen; its only destination field is `to`, a BUS ADDRESS. A probe deposits and pokes; the back-edge that re-opens a node whose intention did not work is the OWNER's act at the register (Law 6).

A PROBE BERTHS WITH WHAT IT WATCHES, NOT WITH ITS INTENT — a deliberate Law 5 exception, recorded so it is not 'fixed' later. Intent, voyage and proofs share an address; a probe is none of the three. It is an INSTRUMENT, and an instrument berths at what it measures. This EXTENDS the three-roots test rather than breaking it: for a compiled probe, 'does the intention have ONE code address?' becomes 'what does it WATCH, and where does THAT live?'. Three destinations placed both real probes with no fourth case and no exception clause — including system_rackmount, which looks like a counter-example and is not: it checks in no probe at all, only a runtime factory.

THE FIRST LIVE FIRE CAUGHT ITS BUILDER TWICE WHERE FOUR GREEN PROOFS HAD NOT, and both bugs were this ticket's own disease. (1) The corpus counted THIS ticket — the node that invented the mechanism, counting its own participation as evidence that authors participate. Home-field advantage as a measurement, at n=1, by the maximally motivated author. (2) `enough` had no sample-size floor while `_trigger` required 12, so the watch could CLEAR at n=1 but could not FIRE until n=12: guaranteed to retire before it could ever bite — a summons crossed by everybody and satisfied by nobody, which is precisely what the probe exists to detect. Either bug alone was fatal. The pattern holds: first live fires keep catching their builders.

A RENAME IS NEVER BEHAVIOUR-FREE IN A SYSTEM THAT CHECKS REFS IN THE WORLD — hypothesis H1, killed by its own text. The rename FALSIFIED THIS TICKET'S OWN CHART REFS BY SUCCEEDING: the WATCHME crossing was refused with five findings naming cairn/tools/base/callback.py and two renamed proofs, the three addresses this ticket's own decompose piece had renamed hours earlier. Disposed by a forwarding order on the record of truth plus a new both-ends filter (build_inspector.forwarding_order_resolves, taking it 17 filters to 18) — never by editing the berths to match. And the enumerated sweep list was itself incomplete: bus-completion.json's LIVE spec named a renamed class, a renamed method and two renamed files that the list never mentioned. An enumerated sweep list is a HYPOTHESIS about completeness, not a statement of it.

A PRECEDENT TRANSFERS ON THE SHAPE OF THE CHANGE, NOT THE SHAPE OF THE ARTIFACT — hypothesis H4, killed by its own falsifier. The skill-class stone had proved 'a version lands in the class file ALONE, zero lines of transitions.py change', and that was read as covering any new version. It did not: WATCHME ROAMS AND NAMES ITS OBJECT, and v1's fixed-position path grammar could not express a free summons, so commit fb03f42 had to teach the parser FREE SUMMONSES. Adding a version is free; adding a GRAMMAR is not.

THE MIGRATION REWRITES NOBODY'S PAST. The workflow string lives in every journaled history entry and history is append-only, so a node migrates when its NEXT journaled crossing names v2 — its past entries go on honestly naming v1, and the migrating entry carries `migrated_from` with the v1 string intact: the old shape PRESERVED in the act of leaving it. Measured in anger on cairn/tools/base at history idx 18, pre-migration prefix hash 9e068d1ca50df84a unchanged. The two nodes standing AT LEARNME were the design driver, not an edge case, and they need no no-op self-loop: PROVED is already a legal target from LEARNME on v1.

USE VS MENTION IS THE LINE A VOCABULARY SWEEP MUST NOT CROSS. A record of truth says what was true when it was written and is never edited to look consistent (Law 7). So the sweep forwarded LIVE POINTERS and left DATED CAPTURES byte-identical — in bus-completion.json, ten live spec lines forwarded and Akien's dated 2026-07-25 verbatim ('the callback is the tool. the poke is the act') untouched, with the forwarding itself recorded in provenance. The cheap alternative — relabelling tickets as 'records of truth' so the grep passes — was available and refused.

watchme.trigger: Every ground_loop pulse reaching cairn/tools/base's shim. The probe reads class-space only — it globs CairnCommons/tickets/*.json and counts, over tickets claiming a version whose vocabulary CAN carry a watch (v1 tickets are excluded by their own registered vocabulary, not by a list), how many carry a WATCHME and how many recorded "none, because X". No device, no bus, no network, so it is cheap enough to sit on a pulse. THE OWNING TICKET IS EXCLUDED FROM ITS OWN CORPUS and the count must reach 12 eligible before either predicate answers — both added by the live fire, 2026-07-30 (see `enough`).
watchme.enough: CLEARED once the corpus is BIG ENOUGH TO JUDGE (>= 12 eligible tickets) AND some OTHER node has carried a watch. At that moment the question is answered — optional does not mean never — and a standing watch on a settled question is the re-derivation Law 1 refuses. If the answer later goes bad, that is a NEW watch a node carries deliberately, not this one silently resuming. THE SAMPLE-SIZE FLOOR AND THE SELF-EXCLUSION WERE ADDED BY THIS NODE'S OWN LIVE FIRE, 2026-07-30, and this text said neither before. As first written the clear read 'the moment ANY node carries a watch' with no floor, while the trigger next door required 12 — so the watch could CLEAR at n=1 and could not FIRE until n=12, guaranteed to retire before it could ever bite; and the corpus counted THIS ticket, so the n=1 was the author of the mechanism counting their own participation as evidence that authors participate. A watch that clears before it can fire is the v1 LEARNME failure wearing this node's clothes — the exact shape this probe exists to detect.
watchme.carrier: The default: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier, written through cairn.machines.chart.verdict.write_verdict against falsifier@watchme-emits-a-probe — the form built in piece (d) precisely so a probe firing months from now has a criteria source that does not depend on a berthed chart chain surviving.
watchme.nexus: hypothesize — the tree that remembers what killed which. This ticket's whole claim is a prediction about how authors behave once a summons is optional; the hypothesize tree is where a prediction that did not hold belongs.
watchme.consumer: AKIEN, through the owner's gate. The probe deposits and pokes; it has NO authority to back-edge this node (Law 6). What it can do is put a measured 'zero of N eligible nodes carried a watch' in front of the owner, whose act the back-edge then is.

dependencies:
PIECE (a) — WHERE A COMPILED PROBE BERTHS. RULED BY AKIEN 2026-07-30, and it corrects two wrong turns worth recording so neither is re-taken. FIRST WRONG TURN: cairn/tools/base/probe.py's header justifies class-space FROM A MISAPPLIED WORD — 'because it is DECLARATION, it lives with the device's CODE'. A probe is NOT the declaration. The DECLARATION is the intent, and the intent is on the TICKET; the probe is an EXPRESSION of that intent (when this happens, call this, with this). So the placement argument in that header has nothing under it and must be rewritten with the rest of piece (e). SECOND WRONG TURN (CC's, twice): first placing a per-ticket watcher beside its ticket's component, then collapsing everything into instance-space. Both wrong on the same axis.

THE RULE: A PROBE IS COMPILED INTENT — EXACTLY AS CODE IS COMPILED INTENT — AND IT BERTHS WITH WHAT IT WATCHES, NOT WITH THE TICKET IT WAS COMPILED FROM. So a probe's folder is routinely nowhere near its ticket, and probes CLUSTER BY SUBJECT: a device's time-related watchers share a folder in that device, as do the watchers over one piece of code. Three destinations, chosen by the subject:
  (i) WATCHES THE TOOLS -> IN THE REPO, beside the monitored code, CHECKED IN. Someone who installs this repo needs these to have working tools — they are part of what the tool IS.
  (ii) WATCHES THIS INSTANCE'S RUNTIME, or is a standing ask from this user -> instance-space (Akien's example, fictitious: 'watch for parsimonious and AI appearing close together' -> ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/librarian/probes_for_learning/).
  (iii) WATCHES A DOWNSTREAM PROJECT -> that project's own repo, because that project's ticket workflow lives there (Akien's example: an Acurite weather app built with these tools carries its own probes in its own repo, on our work process) — and ITS user-specific learning points at that user's own runtime path, outside both of our roots entirely.

DELIBERATE EXCEPTION TO LAW 5, recorded so it is not 'fixed' later: intent, voyage and proofs share an address, but a probe is none of the three — it is an INSTRUMENT, and an instrument berths at what it measures. A probe far from its ticket reads as drift and is not.

EXTENDS THE THREE-ROOTS TEST rather than breaking it: CLAUDE.md asks 'does the intention have ONE code address?'. For a compiled probe the question becomes 'what does it WATCH, and where does THAT live?' — same question, different subject.

AND IT ANSWERS THE INSTALL QUESTION, which is the half Akien opened this with: a stranger cloning the repo must get the tool-watching probes as checked-in code that ARMS ITSELF on their host, with none of our work-watchers firing on their box. That makes a shipped probe a HOST-SEAM in shape — a declaration that must apply and verify against a host it has never seen — so it lands on ticket host-seam-installer's known gap (host-seams declare apply/verify as PROSE with no machine-readable `applies-to` field). The two are COUPLED, not sequential.

PIECE (b) — THE CLASS TABLES AND THE GRAMMAR. Mint code-seam@v2 and skill@v2: LEARNME leaves the path, WATCHME may appear ZERO OR MORE times at any position, and a bare `WATCHME` with no spec is refused at parse. This is a NEW VERSION and not a widening of v1 (recorded as CC's read, see provenance): the path itself changes, versions are immutable and version-stamped, and migration-by-find-and-replace is the mechanism MAP.md already names for exactly this. cairn/tools/base/transitions.py's exact-sequence conformance refuses a zero-or-more state today, so the parser is real work. Every at-sea node's string migrates; the migration is journaled, never silent.

PIECE (c) — THE SPEC AND THE EMISSION GATE. The WATCHME spec (trigger, enough-condition, carrier, nexus, consumer) becomes a required structure at ticketing, and the emit chokepoint refuses a forward crossing out of WATCHME unless the probe it names is ARMED — emission, not accumulation. THE DWELL FALLS OUT ELSEWHERE AND IS NOT A SECOND MODE (settled with Akien): a mid-workflow node that must accumulate before continuing dwells because the NEXT summons is gated on data that has not arrived, not because WATCHME holds it. One state, one act — emit.

PIECE (d) — THE FEEDBACK CONTRACT, GENERALIZED. `validate_ref` admits a second provenance form (`falsifier@<ticket-id>`) so a verdict whose criteria come from the ticket's falsifier rather than from a berthed chart validate packet is legal. `nexus` becomes a specified parameter rather than the hardwired `hypothesize`. Carriage beyond a verdict artifact is legal when the spec names its shape and consumer. The return route reuses what exists verbatim: outcome=pass deposits and rests; outcome=fail is a kick-back, which is already how the exit gate routes a failed criterion — the ONLY new part is the rest-state form (a fail must MOVE an already-resting node backward, where today a fail refuses a crossing), and per Law 6 that move is the OWNER's act on reading a failed verdict, with the probe only depositing and poking.

PIECE (e) — THE PROSE THAT MUST MOVE WITH THE PHYSICS, each pairing its write with a recompile-gate poke. intentions-not-beside-code/I-heartbeat-probes-and-bus.md lines 95-99 ('LEARNING is a state; a probe is the worker... a node IN LEARNING can SET a probe') — SUPERSEDED, this is the exclusive-and-terminal collision. MAP.md's 'Two rests, both inside the one loop' section — rewritten; there is one rest, and the standing work lives in the probe, which is not a node state at all. /sail step 8 stops being a LEARNME crossing (the close-deposit is bookkeeping the close does, not a summons). /sorted casts the WATCHME spec by default and records 'none, because X' when there isn't one. cairn/tools/base/probe.py's own header carries the superseded sentence and must move with it.

This design adds no primitive; it adds an obligation and a gate.

The heartbeat + shim path (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop, cairn/tools/base/shim.py) — falsifier clause (2) is unmeasurable until a device's probes demonstrably fire on a beat. NOT a blocker for the build; IS a blocker for believing the result.

PIECE (f) — THE VOCABULARY: CALLBACK BECOMES PROBE. RULED BY AKIEN 2026-07-30, folded into this build rather than cast separately, and done FIRST so nothing is built on the old word. HIS FORMULATION: 'that IS what it does PROGRAMMATICALLY... but what it DOES FUNCTIONALLY is: it's a probe.' The rename is not cosmetic — the thing had ALREADY become a probe and the name lagged. We ruled earlier the same day that it carries NO AUTHORITY (it deposits and it pokes; the owner acts), and its own header already describes firing as 'kick off a short-lived process that sends a message to the target's shim, then terminates'. So it is structurally incapable of anything but OBSERVE A CONDITION AND REPORT WHAT IT SAW. 'Probe' names that; 'callback' named the plumbing by which the report is delivered.

WHAT FALLS OUT FOR FREE, which is the tell that the rename is real: (1) piece (a)'s placement rule stops needing an argument — 'a probe berths at what it measures' is self-evident where 'a callback berths at what it measures' required a ruling; the name forces the content, which is the naming stone working as designed. (2) The bad justification in piece (a) cannot even be WRITTEN about a probe ('because it is DECLARATION, it lives with the device's CODE'). (3) 'WATCHME emits a probe' reads as one idea, where 'WATCHME emits a callback' read as a state emitting a function pointer.
